title: IT Data Center Engineer (Kabul & Mazar)
description:
Role Summary
Responsible for the operation, administration, performance, security and availability of ATOMA enterprise Linux, VMware, storage, backup and Disaster Recovery infrastructure across Primary and DR Data Centers. The position provides hands-on administration of Linux server platforms, VMware vSphere/ESXi/vCenter, enterprise storage, Veritas NetBackup and tape-library environments, physical server hardware and recovery operations. The engineer also provides operational cross-coverage for Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and related Microsoft infrastructure services to support resilient and highly available Data Center operations, the position also provides administration and operational support for Pi-hole DNS, Veeam Backup and Recovery, and enterprise privileged access management (PAM) platforms used within ATOMA Data Center infrastructure.

Duties and Responsibilities
· Administer and maintain enterprise Linux servers including RHEL, Oracle Linux, Ubuntu and related platforms across Primary and Disaster Recovery Data Centers.
· Administer VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter environments, including clusters, hosts, virtual machines, templates, resource allocation, HA/DRS, virtual networking, datastores and capacity management.
· Administer and support enterprise storage platforms including Dell EMC and Huawei storage, covering pools, volumes/LUNs, host mapping, datastore presentation, capacity and performance monitoring.
· Administer and support Veritas NetBackup Flex and enterprise backup infrastructure, including clients, policies, schedules, retention, job monitoring, troubleshooting and restore operations.
· Administer and support Pi-hole DNS infrastructure, including DNS forwarding, upstream DNS configuration, local DNS records, allow/block policies, service availability, logging, troubleshooting and configuration backup.
· Monitor and maintain Pi-hole DNS availability and integration with Active Directory DNS and other enterprise DNS services.
· Administer and support Veeam Backup and Recovery environments, including backup jobs, repositories, schedules, retention policies, replication, restore operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.
· Perform regular backup and restore validation using Veeam and Veritas NetBackup to ensure recoverability of critical systems.
· Administer and support enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, including PAM360 or equivalent platforms, for secure privileged access to Linux, VMware, storage, backup and Data Center infrastructure.
· Manage privileged accounts, access policies, password vaulting, session access, audit logs and approved administrative access through PAM..
· Operate and support enterprise tape-library environments, including media handling, inventory, retention tracking, duplication/offsite processes and restore readiness.
· Perform Linux installation, configuration, patching, package management, service administration, user/permission management, filesystem/LVM administration, performance tuning and troubleshooting.
· Perform VMware lifecycle activities including ESXi patching, host maintenance, VM administration, snapshot management, resource optimization, firmware compatibility and approved platform upgrades.
· Support SAN and storage integration with VMware and Linux environments, including multipathing, HBA connectivity, LUN/datastore mapping and coordination of zoning or path-related activities with relevant teams.
· Monitor storage utilization, performance, capacity trends and hardware health; investigate latency, path, capacity or availability issues and coordinate corrective actions with vendors and technical teams.
· Monitor backup success, failed jobs, retention compliance and recovery-point coverage; perform and document regular restore tests to validate backup integrity and recovery procedures.
· Administer and troubleshoot Dell, HPE and Huawei physical server platforms, including RAID, NIC/HBA, firmware, hardware health, diagnostics, replacement and vendor escalation.
· Participate in Disaster Recovery planning, replication/recovery activities, DR testing, recovery sequencing, VM/server restoration and documentation of recovery procedures for critical infrastructure services.
· Monitor Linux, VMware, storage, backup and server infrastructure using enterprise monitoring platforms and take preventive or corrective action to maintain availability and performance.
· Implement approved operating system, virtualization, storage and backup security hardening, privileged access controls, patching and vulnerability remediation in coordination with Information Security.
· Use shell scripting, PowerCLI, Ansible, PowerShell or other approved automation methods to standardize builds, health checks, backup reporting, capacity analysis and routine infrastructure administration.
· Integrate infrastructure platforms with DNS, NTP, LDAP/Active Directory, monitoring, backup, logging and security services as required.
· Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for critical Linux, VMware, storage, backup, hardware and recovery incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive actions.
· Provide secondary operational support for Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365/Exchange, SCCM/WSUS and related Microsoft services when required for cross-platform coverage.
· Maintain accurate server/VM inventories, storage maps, backup architecture, retention schedules, media records, configuration standards, DR runbooks, diagrams and technical documentation; follow ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management processes.
· Provide 24x7/on-call support when required for critical infrastructure incidents, backup/restore requests, maintenance windows, Disaster Recovery events or Data Center operations.

Job Requirements
Education:
· Bachelor's degree (BCS) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field from a reputable university of Afghanistan or abroad.
Experience:
· Minimum 8+ years in Enterprise Infrastructure and Data Center Operations, including experience within a telecommunications company or telecom service-provider environment. Strong hands-on experience in Linux administration, VMware virtualization, enterprise storage, backup, Disaster Recovery and physical server hardware is required. Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft 365 is required for cross-platform support. Experience supporting 24x7 mission-critical environments is required.
Training & Preferred Certifications:
· Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Oracle Linux, LFCS/LFCE or equivalent Linux administration certification
· VMware Certified Professional - Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV) or equivalent VMware certification
· Enterprise storage administration certification from Dell Technologies, Huawei or equivalent
· Veritas NetBackup administration/certification or equivalent enterprise backup certification
· Microsoft Windows Server / Microsoft 365 fundamentals or administration certification is an advantage
· ITIL Foundation, Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity and fundamental networking certifications are advantages

Interested Afghan nationals can send their applications and resumes (with three valid references) by Sep 24, 2026 .
Please mention the name of the position and your province in your e-mail subject line.
Only the applications received from the individuals residing in the mentioned province who meet the requirements will be considered.
Applications received after the deadline and those that do not meet the requirements mentioned above will not be considered.

title: Manager - Network Audit and Quality (Re-Announced)
description:
Role Summary
The Network Audit and Quality Manager will be responsible for ensuring the Network infrastructure, Network quality, and compliance meets Telecom and Regulatory standards and will oversee Network audits, monitor Service Quality, identify gaps, and Drive Continuous improvement across Transmission, IP, Radio, Core, O&M and Network Implementation.

Duties and Responsibilities
1. General Audit (Site Physical & Hardware, Licenses):
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive audit plan aligned with business priorities and risk areas.
• Establish audit methodologies, checklists, standards, and best practices.
• Ensure audit approaches are systematic, repeatable, and risk-based.
• Identify, assess, and prioritize network risks based on audit findings and performance trends.
• Evaluate the effectiveness of controls and mitigation measures.
• Recommend risk treatment plans and monitor risk reduction progress.
• Conduct regular and scheduled physical audits of network sites and infrastructure.
• Verify site assets, configurations, installations, and hardware health.
• Ensure compliance with internal standards, safety procedures, and operational readiness.
• Coordinate corrective actions for site deviations and track closure
• Audit all network software, tools, and platforms for accuracy and proper configuration.
• Validate data integrity and alignment between OSS systems and actual network conditions.
• Identify gaps in tool adoption and recommend corrective actions.
• Maintain audit trails and evidence for all tool audits.
• Assess performance, configuration, alarms, and network behavior against standards.
• Provide technical insights and recommendations based on audit findings.
• Identify network gaps, risks, and performance degradation trends
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance network quality and customer experience
• Validate network expansions, upgrades, and new deployments through acceptance audits
• Manage and track audit findings, corrective actions, and closure timelines
• Collaborate with planning, optimization, and operations teams to resolve issues
• Prepare and present quality reports, dashboards, and executive summaries
4. Network Planning and Optimization Audit:
• Audit RF planning outputs to verify that coverage maps, capacity plans, and frequency allocations match actual field and drive test results.
• Review drive test results, propagation model tuning, and KPI analytics to confirm adherence to quality and design standards.
• Verify that microwave and fiber transmission links meet performance standards (latency, throughput, jitter, loss) and that planned topology reflects physical implementation.
• Assess fault tolerance, redundancy, and backup mechanisms in transmission planning to support SLA and continuity requirements during failures.
5. Contracts Compliance & Verification:
• Review service contracts, SLA and KPI frameworks, and vendor deliverables.
• Verify performance against targets and contractual commitments.
• Prepare detailed verification reports and recommend corrective actions when KPIs are not met.
• Lead contract performance reviews with vendors and internal stakeholders.
6. Disaster Recovery (DR) Site Verification:
• Conduct audits of disaster recovery sites and backup infrastructure.
• Validate readiness, redundancy, and failover capabilities.
• Ensure DR mechanisms meet business continuity and SLA requirements.
7. Regulatory & Licensing Audits (ATRA and Others):
• Lead audits related to regulatory compliance, licensing requirements, and reporting obligations.
• Ensure network operations comply with ATRA, telecom laws, and other regulatory frameworks.
• Prepare documentation and evidence for regulatory inspections and audits.
8. Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement:
• Establish quality standards and frameworks for network operations and audit processes.
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives based on audit outcomes and trend analysis.
• Facilitate quality workshops and implementation of best practices across teams.
9. Documentation:
• Maintain audit documentation, policies, procedures, and evidence repositories.
• Develop and deliver training for internal teams on audit readiness, compliance, and quality standards.
• Promote awareness of quality assurance principles throughout the organization.

Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering.
Masters degree is preferred
Experience:
· 5–10 years of experience in telecom (network operations, planning, optimization, or QA)
· At least 2–3 years in a quality assurance or audit-related role preferred

Please mention the name of the position you are applying for in your email subject line.
Applications received after the deadline and those that do not meet the requirements mentioned above will not be considered.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the interview(s).

title: Chief Technology Officer

The CTO will ensure that Ghazanfar Pay’s technology infrastructure is secure, scalable, interoperable, and compliant with EMI regulations and industry best practices. Ensure scalability, modularity, and high availability of all technology systems.

Enable real-time dashboards for management, operations, compliance, and risk monitoring.
Promote data-driven decision-making and customer insight capabilities.
Oversee AI, automation, and digital optimization initiatives.
Ensure data quality, availability, and integrity across systems.
People, Capability & Performance Management
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing technology and digital team.
Establish continuous learning and certification programs.
Define clear KPIs, performance dashboards, and service accountability frameworks.
Promote a culture of innovation, resilience, cybersecurity awareness, and operational discipline.
Ensure succession planning and local capacity development.
Enforce ethical, professional, and secure technology practices.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred).
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, TOGAF, ITIL, or cloud/security certifications highly desirable.
Experience
Minimum 8–10 years of experience in technology leadership roles within EMI, fintech, telecom, banking, or payment services.
At least 3–5 years in a senior management or CTO/Head of Technology role.
Proven experience implementing large-scale digital payment platforms and high-availability systems.
Strong expertise in cybersecurity, systems integration, APIs, and payment switching.
Demonstrated experience working with regulators, audits, and compliance-driven environments.
Strong understanding of mobile money ecosystems, EMI platforms, and digital financial infrastructure.
Experience in emerging markets or fragile operating environments preferred.

Strategic technology leadership and execution capability.
Strong systems architecture and cybersecurity expertise.

The incumbent will work closely with the Mining Project Manager, Mining Engineer, and Geology Department to identify, assess, and evaluate iron ore deposits and support the development of reliable geological models and mineral resource estimates.
The role involves geological mapping, sampling, drilling, core logging, geophysical and geochemical investigations, data analysis, and technical reporting to guide exploration, mine planning, and extraction activities. The Geologist will ensure that exploration programs are conducted accurately, safely, cost-effectively, and in compliance with applicable mining regulations and environmental standards.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities
Geological Mapping and Iron Ore Exploration
Conduct geological mapping and surveys in identified iron ore exploration areas.
Identify and document iron-bearing formations, mineralized zones, geological structures, and ore bodies.
Prepare geological maps, cross-sections, and technical reports based on field observations and exploration data.
Design and implement exploration programs, including geological mapping, surface sampling, trenching, and drilling.
Conduct mineral prospecting to identify potential iron ore deposits and areas requiring further exploration.
Assess geological formations and mineralization patterns to support exploration and mine development.
Develop and maintain exploration plans, budgets, and implementation schedules.
Coordinate exploration activities with the Mining and Geology Departments.
Geological Sampling and Data Collection
Collect and supervise the collection of rock, soil, channel, trench, and drill core samples.
Ensure proper sample identification, labeling, documentation, preservation, and transportation.
Develop and implement sampling procedures to maintain data quality and reliability.
Coordinate sample preparation and laboratory analysis of iron ore samples.
Monitor iron ore quality indicators, including iron content (Fe), silica (SiO₂), alumina (Al₂O₃), phosphorus (P), and sulfur (S), where applicable.
Maintain accurate records of geological observations, sample results, and exploration activities.
Ensure proper chain-of-custody procedures for geological samples.
Drilling and Core Logging
Plan and coordinate geological drilling programs for subsurface exploration.
Assist in selecting drilling locations based on geological information and exploration objectives.
Supervise drilling contractors and monitor drilling progress and performance.
Conduct and supervise core logging, including lithology, mineralization, alteration, weathering, fractures, and geological structures.
Ensure accurate recording of drill hole information, core recovery, and sample intervals.
Coordinate drill core sampling and quality control procedures.
Review laboratory results and integrate drilling data into geological interpretations.
Prepare drilling progress reports and technical recommendations for further exploration.
Geophysical and Geochemical Exploration
Plan and coordinate geophysical surveys to support iron ore exploration.
Supervise applicable magnetic, electrical, gravity, and other geophysical investigations.
Coordinate geochemical exploration programs for soil, rock, and other relevant samples.
Interpret geophysical and geochemical results alongside geological mapping and drilling data.
Identify potential mineralized zones and recommend additional exploration activities.
Maintain accurate records of geophysical and geochemical survey results.
Ensure exploration methods are selected according to geological conditions and project requirements.
Geological Modeling and Mineral Resource Evaluation
Integrate geological, drilling, geophysical, and geochemical data to develop geological interpretations and 3D models.
Use GIS and geological modeling software such as ArcGIS, QGIS, Leapfrog, Micromine, or other applicable tools.
Develop and update geological maps, sections, and geological models.
Support the estimation and evaluation of iron ore mineral resources.
Assist in interpreting ore body geometry, mineralization continuity, and ore quality distribution.
Collaborate with resource geologists and mining engineers on resource estimation and mine planning.
Identify areas requiring additional drilling, sampling, or geological investigation.
Support the preparation of technical resource reports in accordance with applicable reporting standards and project requirements.
Exploration Planning and Project Management
Prepare detailed exploration programs, work plans, budgets, and implementation schedules.
Manage and monitor exploration activities to ensure compliance with approved plans.
Supervise field geologists, geological technicians, survey teams, and other exploration personnel.
Coordinate with drilling contractors, laboratories, and other technical service providers.
Monitor exploration expenses and ensure the efficient utilization of project resources.
Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising technical quality or safety.
Prepare regular progress reports covering exploration activities, challenges, expenses, and key findings.
Conduct post-exploration evaluations and recommend improvements to future programs.
Provide technical recommendations regarding further exploration and potential mine development.
Technical Reporting and Documentation
Prepare geological mapping, exploration, drilling, sampling, and resource evaluation reports.
Review geological data and ensure the accuracy and completeness of technical documentation.
Maintain organized records of geological maps, drill logs, laboratory results, survey data, and exploration reports.
Present exploration findings and technical recommendations to senior management and project teams.
Prepare technical presentations explaining geological information and exploration results.
Support the preparation of feasibility studies and technical documentation for mine development.
Ensure geological information is properly documented and available for future exploration and mining activities.
Health, Safety, Environment, and Social Affairs
Implement and monitor health and safety procedures during geological fieldwork and exploration activities.
Ensure exploration teams follow safety requirements during drilling, sampling, surveying, and field operations.
Identify field hazards and take appropriate corrective and preventive measures.
Monitor field conditions and ensure the safe operation of exploration activities.
Support environmental assessments and the implementation of environmental mitigation measures.
Ensure exploration activities comply with applicable environmental regulations and approved project requirements.
Support the rehabilitation of exploration sites, including drill pads, trenches, and access areas, where required.
Coordinate with local communities, government authorities, and stakeholders to facilitate exploration activities.
Assist in obtaining required exploration permits and licenses in coordination with management.
Team Leadership and Technical Development
Provide technical guidance and supervision to junior geologists, field technicians, and exploration teams.
Conduct training and mentoring on geological mapping, sampling, core logging, and data collection.
Establish and monitor quality control procedures for geological and exploration data.
Promote the use of appropriate exploration technologies and methodologies.
Evaluate the application of modern tools such as drones, remote sensing, AI-assisted geological analysis, and other relevant technologies.
Maintain professional knowledge of developments in geological exploration and iron ore resource evaluation.
Coordinate with Mining Engineers, Environmental Specialists, Surveyors, and other professionals to align exploration objectives with project requirements.

Coordinate exploration activities between the Geology Department, Mining Department, Project Manager, contractors, and senior management.
Ensure exploration activities are conducted according to approved technical plans and industry best practices.
Maintain effective working relationships with relevant government authorities, including the Ministry of Mines and Petroleum.

description:
Job Summary
The Cybersecurity Specialist will help protect the organization's systems, employee devices, financial products, and
customer data from cyber threats. The role supports secure product development, monitors endpoints and
infrastructure, strengthens day-to-day security controls, and promotes good security habits across the company.
This is a practical growth role for a curious security professional who can work closely with developers, support staff,
respond calmly to incidents, and translate security risks into clear actions.

Job Requirements
Core Security Skills
- Understanding of common threats, including phishing, malware, ransomware, social engineering, and credential theft.
- Basic network security knowledge covering firewalls, VPNs, secure Wi-Fi, endpoint access, and least privilege.
- Experience with, or willingness to learn, endpoint monitoring tools such as Wazuh and comparable EDR or SIEM-lite
platforms.
- Basic vulnerability scanning experience with Nessus, OpenVAS, or similar tools.
- Basic penetration testing concepts and familiarity with Burp Suite Community, OWASP ZAP, or equivalent tools.
- Understanding of the OWASP Top 10, basic web and API behavior, SQL fundamentals, and injection risks.
- Comfort reading and writing basic Python and/or Bash scripts for simple automation.
Tools and Fintech Knowledge - Advantageous, Not Mandatory
- Familiarity with PCI-DSS or a clear willingness to learn its requirements.
- Awareness of data privacy principles, including GDPR concepts or relevant local equivalents.
- Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow.
- Basic knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud security fundamentals.
Preferred Certifications

- Vendor-specific training in Wazuh, endpoint security, or cloud-provider security fundamentals.
- Certifications are preferred but are not mandatory when supported by strong practical experience.
Communication and Personal Attributes
- Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to explain security issues to technical and non-technical colleagues.
- Genuine curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in a fast-changing field.
- Patient and clear when delivering staff training or guiding users through security issues.
- Collaborative team player who is comfortable working closely with developers and IT colleagues.
- Organized and reliable when tracking alerts, vulnerabilities, patches, updates, and follow-up actions.
Education and Experience
- Degree, diploma, or equivalent practical experience in IT, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
- Strong self-taught candidates with a demonstrable track record are encouraged to apply.
- 1-3 years of IT or cybersecurity experience; internships, junior roles, and hands-on personal projects are relevant.
- Exposure to fintech, startups, financial products, or sensitive customer data is an advantage, not a requirement.

- Device patch compliance and the proportion of company systems kept up to date.

- Reduction in phishing and other preventable security incidents over time.
- Response time to flagged issues on monitored endpoints and systems.

Role Summary
To lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework across e& Afghanistan by providing independent risk oversight, challenge, monitoring, reporting, and advisory support to promote effective management of risks within the approved risk appetite. The role serves as a second-line risk oversight function, promoting a strong risk culture and informed decision-making. In addition, the role provides independent oversight of the Internal Controls Framework and coordinates and monitors risk-based control review, testing, and remediation activities in alignment with e& Group requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, evaluation, monitoring, and reporting activities covering strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, technology, business continuity, and reputational risks.
• Facilitate periodic risk assessments and Risk C Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across business functions to identify emerging risks, assess control effectiveness, and evaluate residual risk exposure.
• Maintain the Enterprise Risk Register, ensuring significant risks are appropriately documented, assessed, assigned to risk owners, and supported by mitigation plans.
• Develop, maintain, and monitor risk appetite statements, risk tolerance thresholds, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Key Control Indicators (KCIs), and escalate significant breaches and exposures to management.
• Facilitate and oversee the documentation and periodic review of risks, controls, control ownership, testing procedures, and remediation plans for critical business processes.
• Coordinate and oversee the annual Internal Controls Review and Testing Program to assess the design adequacy and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Identify control deficiencies, process weaknesses, and governance gaps through risk and control assessments, and provide independent recommendations to management to strengthen the effectiveness of the control environment.
• Monitor and report the implementation status of risk mitigation actions, control remediation plans, and risk-related recommendations arising from Internal Audit, External Audit, regulatory reviews, and management assessments.
• Prepare and present periodic risk and internal control reports to the VP Risk C Assurance, Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC), and the Audit C Risk Management Committee (ARMC), highlighting key risk exposures, emerging risks, control weaknesses, trends, and mitigation progress.
• Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Information Security, Finance, Technology, Human Resources, and business functions to enhance enterprise-wide risk and control management practices.

• Provide independent oversight of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises and monitor implementation of agreed improvement actions.
• Evaluate cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, technology, and network resilience risks in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and ensure such risks are appropriately reflected in the Enterprise Risk Register.

The Field & Research Data Collection Coordinator will support the planning, coordination, supervision, and implementation of quantitative and qualitative research activities.

· Provide regular progress updates on field activities.

· Coordinate staff availability, deployment, and deliverables.

title: Lecturer/Assistant Professor - PhD in Computer Science
description:
Role Summary
Are you a passionate, energetic and a result-oriented individual with strong communication skills and solid knowledge? If yes, this opportunity is for you. Kardan University is seeking experienced and motivated Lecturers/Assistant Professors to join our team of academicians and researchers.
Reporting to the Academic Administrator of the Department, the assistant professor/lecturer will be responsible for teaching and assessing students periodically through a set of evaluation mechanisms. He will also be responsible to review and revise the curriculum with the academic committee of the university.
We offer an exciting work environment conducive to academic and professional development of our Employees. Kardan University offers a competitive salary in the higher education industry.

Duties and Responsibilities
Duties & Responsibilities:
Facilitate student learning, provide effective instruction, and perform evaluations of student learning for all assigned classes
Build up professional logistics which helps in improvising the performances of the student.
Develop course handouts, lectures, labs, and presentations.
Participate in program level learning assessment
Participate in developing learning outcomes, choosing and administering measures, evaluating student performance, and suggesting changes to improve student learning.
Work with other faculty and administrators in developing program curriculum, standards, and policies, including reviewing and participating in textbook selection process where appropriate.
Guide, direct and mentor research scholars in their research projects.
Assess, supervise and mentor the academic progress in students.
Create, innovate and implement some activities and programs that help in career-enhancement.
Take part in all activities of the department, faculty and the University.
Support and serve up for various functional activities conducted by departmental committees.
Review, assess and evaluate the activities and progress of students.
Lend a hand, support and aid the Academic Administrator and Dean in their everyday functions and tasks.
Publish their research works or findings in academic books or journals.
Grade papers and tests; prepare exercises, lessons and lab experiments for the students.
Teach graduate as well as the undergraduate students within their field of expertise.
Submit the sessional and final results of the students within a week after midterm/ terminal examination.
Assist examination department and make presence in the examination hall during examinations and in the conduction of entry test.
Perform any other relevant task given by the management of Kardan University.

Job Requirements
PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science , or a closely related field from a recognized university.
Minimum 03 years of teaching experience at a recognized higher education institution.
Strong academic and professional expertise in at least one of the following areas:
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Cybersecurity and Information Security
Data Science, Data Analytics, and Big Data
Demonstrated ability to teach undergraduate and graduate-level Computer Science courses within the candidate’s area of specialization.
Strong research background with evidence of research publications in recognized academic journals or other scholarly publications .
Ability to supervise and mentor students in research projects, dissertations, and other academic activities.
Demonstrated knowledge of current technologies, methodologies, and developments relevant to the candidate’s area of specialization.
Practical experience with relevant programming languages, software, frameworks, platforms, or analytical tools will be an advantage.
Strong organizational, interpersonal, academic, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to teach effectively in English and command of at least one national language.
At least 80% Master's degree marks or a B grade in the case of a foreign degree.
At least 75% Bachelor's degree marks or a B grade in the case of a foreign degree.
The Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees must demonstrate above 60% field consistency (Degree Relevance) .
The degree must be attested by the Ministry of Higher Education of Afghanistan in the case of a foreign degree.

Submission Guidelines
Qualified candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/resume and cover letter combined into a single PDF document to jobs@kardan.edu.af .
Applicants are required to include the Vacancy Reference Number provided in the vacancy announcement in the subject line of their email .
Example:
HRM/KU/003
Applications that do not include the correct Vacancy Reference Number in the email subject line may not be considered for shortlisting .
The Vacancy Reference Number must be used exactly as stated in the respective vacancy announcement to ensure accurate identification and processing of applications.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to participate in the interview/demonstration , as applicable to the position.
We appreciate the interest of all applicants. Only candidates selected for the next stage of the recruitment process will be contacted.

The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting MOAM’s web, backend, and mobile applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with .NET Core backend development and microservice architecture, Next.js frontend development, Flutter mobile development, and the infrastructure required to run these systems reliably in production.
The position will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of MOAM’s digital logistics ecosystem, including Courier and Cargo products across web and mobile platforms, shared backend services, system integrations, and future digital solutions, with responsibility spanning APIs, distributed services, caching, messaging, observability, databases, containerization, server administration, security, performance, and third-party integrations. The developer is expected to work across the complete software delivery lifecycle and collaborate closely with the Technology Unit and business stakeholders.

A. Backend Development & Microservices

Learning

· Participate in lessons learnt exercises with program teams to improve the activity implementation

Participate in seminars and training workshops which may be useful to the accomplishment of monitoring & evaluation activities and the attainment of the project’s objectives and in restitution workshops.

Update regularly the monitoring & evaluation tools & methodology considering the donors’ indicators, gender, disable persons, protection & « Do No Harm » approaches

مطالعه، تحلیل و پیگیری فعالیت‌های مرتبط به توسعه و بهره‌برداری مؤثر از ذخایر نفت و گاز، از طریق جمع‌آوری و تحلیل معلومات تخنیکی و اقتصادی، بررسی ظرفیت ذخایر، شناسایی فرصت‌های توسعه‌یی و همکاری در طرح‌ریزی برنامه‌های توسعه‌یی، به‌منظور افزایش استفادۀ مؤثر از منابع نفت و گاز و حمایت از تصمیم‌گیری‌های مسلکی، با رعایت قوانین، مقررات، معیارها و طرزالعمل‌های نافذۀ شرکت.

Duties and Responsibilities
· تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربع‌وار و سالانه مربوط به فعالیت‌های توسعه ذخایر نفت و گاز و تنظیم آن مطابق اولویت‌ها و اهداف تعیین‌شدۀ شرکت.
· نظارت، کنترول و تنظیم مؤثر سنسورها، سیستم‌های کنترول و تجهیزات اتوماتیک ذخایر مواد نفتی و گاز مایع و اطمینان از عملکرد مطلوب و مستمر آن‌ها.
· توسعه و مدیریت بر فعالیت‌های اتاق کنترول دیجیتال (Digital Control Room) و سیستم‌های کنترول مرتبط، به‌منظور تأمین نظارت مستمر و کنترول مؤثر وضعیت ذخایر.
· نظارت و کنترول پارامترهای اساسی ذخایر، شامل سطح، فشار، حرارت، جریان و سایر شاخص‌های تخنیکی، و اطمینان از ثبت و گزارش‌دهی منظم اطلاعات مربوطه.
· نظارت بر عملکرد سیستم‌های کنترول اتوماتیک، سیستم‌های آلارم، هشداردهنده‌ها و تجهیزات مرتبط با ایمنی و مصونیت ذخایر و اتخاذ اقدامات لازم در حالات غیرعادی.
· همکاری در تهیه و انکشاف طرح‌ها و برنامه‌های توسعه ذخایر مواد نفت و گاز، با درنظرداشت ظرفیت منابع، امکانات تخنیکی، هزینه‌ها و شرایط عملیاتی.
· ترتیب جداول آماری و مقایسوی از وضعیت ذخایر به تفکیک محل، نوع مواد، ظرفیت و دورۀ زمانی.
· همکاری در ارزیابی اقتصادی و تخنیکی گزینه‌های توسعه ذخایر و مقایسۀ سناریوهای مختلف از لحاظ ظرفیت ذخایر، هزینه، منفعت و امکان‌پذیری اجرایی.
· پیگیری تطبیق برنامه‌ها و پروژه‌های مرتبط با توسعه ذخایر و مقایسۀ پیشرفت فعالیت‌ها با پلان‌های تأییدشده و ارائه گزارش از انحرافات و چالش‌های موجود.
· شناسایی مشکلات و محدودیت‌های تخنیکی، عملیاتی و معلوماتی مؤثر بر توسعه ذخایر و هماهنگی با بخش‌های مربوط برای دریافت راه‌حل‌های مناسب.
· تنظیم و به‌روزرسانی بانک معلومات و اسناد مربوط به ذخایر، مطالعات، طرح‌های توسعه‌یی و نتایج فعالیت‌های انجام‌شده، مطابق سیستم ثبت و نگهداری معلومات شرکت.
· تهیه گزارش‌های تحلیلی، تخنیکی و معلوماتی دوره‌یی در مورد وضعیت ذخایر، ظرفیت توسعه، پیشرفت برنامه‌ها، فرصت‌ها، چالش‌ها و نتایج فعالیت‌های انجام‌شده و ارائه آن به بخش مربوط.
· اشتراک فعال در بازدیدهای ذخایر و بررسی وضعیت موجودی، ظرفیت، تجهیزات و فعالیت‌های عملیاتی در صورت هدایت بخش مربوطه.
· انجام سایر وظایف مسلکی مرتبط به توسعه ذخایر نفت و گاز که مطابق قوانین، مقررات، پالیسی‌ها، طرزالعمل‌ها و هدایات مقامات ذی‌صلاح به وی سپرده می‌شود.

Job Requirements
· داشتن سند تحصیلی حداقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته‌های نفت و گاز، صنایع کیمیاوی تکنالوژی کیمیاو سایر رشته‌های مرتبط به وظیفه.

وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
الف) وظایف اساسی:
1. تنظیم و انکشاف نصاب‌ های تعلیمی رشته‌ ‌ سخت افزار به ‌منظور تأمین انسجام و هماهنگی در محتوای آموزشی ؛
2. مرور و بررسی محتوای نصاب ‌های رشته‌های ‌ سخت افزار ، به ‌منظور اطمینان از مطابقت آن‌ ها با اهداف آموزشی و نیاز های بازارکار ؛
3. شناسایی افراد مسلکی جهت اشتراک در ورکشاپ انکشاف / بازنگری/ اعتباردهی نصاب تعلیمی رشته های ‌ سخت افزار ؛
4. راهنمایی و مشارکت در تعیین اهداف آموزشی، شایستگی ها، محتوا و ابزار و تجهیزات با هیئت انکشاف/ بازنگری نصاب تعلیمی رشته های ‌ سخت افزار ؛
5. ارائه و به‌کارگیری طرح‌ های مؤثر در رشته ‌های ‌ سخت افزار به ‌منظور بهبود کیفیت مواد آموزشی و ممد درسی ؛
6. مرور، اظهارنظر و مشارکت در تألیف، تدوین، ترجمه و تصحیح مواد آموزشی (کتب درسی، لکچر نوت ‌ها و وسایل کمک ‌آموزشی) رشته‌های ‌ سخت افزار به‌ منظور اطمینان از کیفیت علمی و عملی آن ‌ها ؛
7. بررسی فهرست عناوین ممد های درسی (کتب و رساله های علمی اساتید) رشته های مرتبط به رشته های ‌ سخت افزار ؛
8. همکاری در تدوین رهنمود ها و روش‌ های اجرایی نصاب‌ های تعلیمی با توجه به خصوصیات رشته‌ های ‌ سخت افزار به ‌منظور تطبیق مؤثر برنامه های آموزشی ؛
9. ابراز نظر، مطالعه اکتشافی به منظور غنامندی نصاب تعلیمی، کتب درسی، لکچر نوت و ممد درسی با استفاده از منابع علمی و انترنتی، جهت افزایش کیفیت و به ‌روز بودن مواد آموزشی رشته های ‌ سخت افزار ؛
10. تهیه و ترتیب اسناد ورکشاپ و قرار داد های مؤلفین، مترجمین و مصححین مواد آموزشی رشته های تخصص ‌ سخت افزار با رعایت شفافیت و معیار های اصولی ؛
ب) وظایف مدیریتی:
1. ترتیب پلان کاری ماهانه،ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان ریاست، به منظور رسیدن به اهداف تعیین شده؛
2. ارایه گزارش ماهانه، ربعوار، سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های بخش به متخصص مربوطه؛
3. اجرای سایر وظایف مرتبط به عنوان بست که از طرف متخصص مربوطه مطابق به اهداف و خط مشی (پالیسی) اداره سپرده می­شود؛
ج) وظایف همآهنگی:
1. همکاری و هماهنگی مستمر با متخصص مربوطه برای تطبیق معیار های علمی و عملی در مواد آموزشی و نصاب تعلیمی، و تبادل تجربیات برای بهبود کیفیت آموزش در بخش ‌ سخت افزار ؛

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our development team and contribute to the enhancement of our cutting-edge FinTech solutions. You will be responsible for designing and building scalable backend systems using Java and Spring Boot , creating dynamic user interfaces with Angular , and ensuring seamless integrations with third-party services and payment switches. Participate in the complete software development process for FinTech projects, including mobile apps, websites, and digital wallets.
Design and develop scalable frontend and backend components for enterprise-grade applications, meeting high standards for security, performance, and compliance.
Write efficient, maintainable code, and contribute to the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Design and optimize databases (e.g., Oracle) to support applications and ensure data integrity.

Collaborate with team members to translate business requirements into intuitive UI/UX designs.

Frontend Expertise: Proven experience developing modern user interfaces with Angular .
API Development: Experience in designing and building RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party services.

Experience deploying applications on Oracle WebLogic Server.
Familiarity with mobile app development using Flutter.

Knowledge of financial industry protocols like ISO 8583.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume to jobs@aurumaf.com . Please clearly indicate the job title "Full Stack Developer" in the subject line of your email.

title: Network Officer
description:
Job Summary
The Network Officer is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting the Bank network infrastructure under the supervision of the Network Administrator / IT Manager.
The position will assist in maintaining the availability, reliability, performance, and security of network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, IP telephony, network links, and related communication infrastructure.
The Network Officer will also provide technical support to branch IT personnel, assist with network-related projects and implementations, maintain network documentation, perform configuration backup and restoration, and support the Network Administrator in ensuring stable and secure network services for the Bank business operations.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist the Network Administrator in the operation, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of the Bank’s network infrastructure.
Monitor network devices, links, and services to identify connectivity, performance, availability, and security-related issues.
Assist in the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of network devices, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPN devices, and related infrastructure.
Assist the Network Administrator in troubleshooting and maintaining Cisco networking equipment and Sophos firewall infrastructure.
Provide remote and on-site technical support to branch IT personnel for network connectivity and infrastructure-related issues.
Assist in the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Cisco IP phones and related IP telephony infrastructure.
Perform and maintain configuration backups and restoration of network devices in accordance with approved procedures.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date network diagrams, device inventories, IP addressing records, configuration records, and technical documentation.
Prepare and maintain network device configuration notes, implementation records, and other relevant technical documentation.
Assist in the installation, labeling, organization, and maintenance of network cables, patch panels, racks, and related network infrastructure.
Conduct network site surveys for new branches, offices, and other locations and assist in preparing the required network equipment, materials, and technical requirements.
Assist the Network Administrator in analyzing network traffic, performance, and utilization to ensure optimal network availability and performance.
Assist in monitoring and maintaining network security controls to support secure and reliable network operations in accordance with the Bank’s approved IT and information security policies.
Assist in identifying network capacity requirements and support capacity planning based on business and operational requirements.
Assist with the implementation and testing of approved network changes, upgrades, configurations, and infrastructure projects in accordance with the Bank’s change management procedures.
Escalate major network incidents, security concerns, service interruptions, and other critical issues to the Network Administrator / concerned line manager in a timely manner.
Maintain proper records of network incidents, troubleshooting activities, changes, and resolutions for future reference and audit requirements.
Support the Network Administrator in ensuring network availability and business continuity, including support for network-related activities associated with the Bank’ disaster recovery environment.
Coordinate with relevant IT teams, service providers, and vendors, when required, for the resolution of network-related technical issues.
Perform any other network-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the line manager in accordance with the Bank requirements and applicable policies and procedures.

Job Requirements
Required Qualifications and Experience
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certification such as CCNA and CCNP is required or equivalent certification is an advantage.
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in network infrastructure, preferably within a banking, financial, or other enterprise environment.
Practical hands-on experience with Cisco networking devices, including switches, routers and firewalls.
Good working knowledge of firewall, Site to Site VPN IPsec, routing, switching, VLAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and network troubleshooting concepts.
Practical knowledge of Firewall and Cisco security/networking technologies is preferred.
Knowledge and practical experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools is an advantage.
Familiarity with network security principles, access control, segmentation, and secure network operations.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve day-to-day network connectivity and infrastructure issues effectively.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and respond to critical network incidents when required.
Strong interpersonal, communication, coordination, and teamwork skills.
Ability to prepare and maintain accurate technical documentation.
Willingness and ability to work outside normal working hours when required for critical incidents, maintenance, upgrades, or business continuity activities.

Submission Guideline
Qualified and interested applicants are encouraged to apply online through the BMA Job Portal at https://jobs.bma.com.af before the closing date.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.

title: IT Security Analyst
description:
Role Summary
The IT Security Analyst is responsible for protecting the Bank’s information assets, systems, and infrastructure by implementing, monitoring, and enhancing information security controls. The role ensures that cybersecurity risks are effectively identified, managed, and escalated in line with Basel principles, regulatory requirements, and the Bank’s risk appetite .
The position supports operational IT security under the Dy-CIO while ensuring indepndent risk oversight and incident escalation to the CRO

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Information Security Operations
Monitor IT systems, networks, and applications for security threats and vulnerabilities.
Implement and maintain security controls, tools, and configurations.
Support secure system configurations across CBS, applications, servers, and networks.
Ensure compliance with approved IT security standards and policies.
B. Cyber Risk & Incident Management
Detect, analyze, and respond to information security incidents and cyber threats.
Escalate material security incidents, cyber risks, and control weaknesses to the CRO in a timely manner.
Support incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and remediation actions.
Maintain incident logs and prepare incident reports.
C. Governance, Risk & Compliance Support
Support the implementation of the Bank’s Information Security Policy , IT governance framework, and risk controls.
Coordinate with Risk Management to:
Identify IT and cyber risks
Support risk assessments and KRIs
Align controls with the Bank’s risk appetite
Support Compliance requirements related to data protection, access controls, and regulatory expectations.
D. Access Control & Security Monitoring
Monitor and review user access rights to critical systems (including CBS).
Support periodic access reviews and segregation of duties controls.
Ensure timely removal or modification of access for staff movements and terminations.
E. Vulnerability Management & Security Testing
Conduct or coordinate vulnerability assessments and security testing.
Track remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
Support implementation of security patches and system hardening.
F. Audit & Regulatory Support
Act as a focal point for IT security matters during:
Internal Audit
External Audit
Regulatory examinations
Support closure of IT security-related audit findings and regulatory observations.
G. Awareness & Capacity Building
Support IT security awareness initiatives and training programs for staff.
Promote a strong security culture and compliance with security policies.
7. Authority & Escalation
Recommend security improvements and corrective actions.
Escalate high-risk security incidents and systemic weaknesses to Dy-CIO and CRO.
No authority to override business or system decisions without approval.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Professional Certifications (Preferred)
CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, ISO 27001, or equivalent information security certifications.
Experience
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in IT security, cybersecurity, or information risk management.
Experience in banking, financial services, or regulated environments is a strong advantage.

Submission Guidelines
Applicants who meet the above requirements are invited to submit their updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Resume to sr.recruitment-officer@ghazanfarbank.com .

Duties and Responsibilities
English Language Teacher
Deliver English language lessons according to the approved curriculum and course objectives.
Prepare daily lesson plans and teaching materials for effective classroom instruction.
Teach English language skills, including speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, and vocabulary.
Use appropriate teaching methods and activities to meet students’ different learning needs.
Encourage students to actively participate in classroom discussions and activities.
Conduct regular quizzes, tests, assignments, and examinations to assess students’ progress.
Evaluate students’ performance and maintain accurate academic records.
Provide constructive feedback and additional support to students when needed.
Create a positive, respectful, and motivating classroom environment.
Maintain classroom discipline and ensure effective student engagement.
Develop and use supplementary teaching materials, exercises, and activities.
Encourage students to improve their communication and practical English-speaking skills.
Monitor students’ attendance, participation, and overall academic progress.
Participate in teacher meetings, training sessions, workshops, and academic activities.
Coordinate with the academic administration regarding student performance, course progress, and other educational matters.
Computer Trainer
Deliver computer training courses according to the approved curriculum and training schedule. (CIT, DIT, etc…)
Teach basic and advanced computer skills, including MS Office, Windows, internet, and other relevant software.
Prepare lesson plans, training materials, exercises, and practical assignments.
Conduct practical, hands-on training sessions in the computer laboratory.
Explain technical concepts clearly and according to students’ learning levels.
Monitor students’ progress and provide additional support when necessary.
Prepare and administer quizzes, tests, practical exams, and assignments.
Evaluate students’ performance and maintain accurate academic records.
Ensure proper use, care, and maintenance of computers and training equipment.
Troubleshoot basic hardware and software problems during training sessions.
Maintain discipline and create a positive and productive learning environment.
Encourage students to develop practical computer skills through regular exercises and projects.
Keep training materials and course content updated according to current technology and software developments.
Provide guidance and feedback to students regarding their learning progress and skill development.
Coordinate with the academic and management teams regarding class schedules, student performance, and training activities.

Job Requirements
English Language Teacher – Job Requirements
High school graduate (having bachelor’s or master’s is an advantage)
Proven experience in teaching English language courses is preferred.
Strong command of English language skills, including speaking, writing, grammar, and vocabulary.
Ability to teach students at different proficiency levels.
Strong classroom management and student engagement skills.
Ability to prepare effective lesson plans and teaching materials.
Familiarity with modern and interactive teaching methodologies.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Ability to assess students’ performance and provide constructive feedback.
Strong sense of responsibility, professionalism, and commitment.
Ability to work effectively as part of an academic team.
Willingness to work full-time according to the organization’s schedule.
Computer Trainer – Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or relevant diploma/certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience in teaching computer short courses is preferred.
Strong knowledge of computer fundamentals, Windows, MS Office, internet, and other relevant software.
Ability to teach courses such as CIT, DIT, and other computer training programs.
Strong practical knowledge of computer hardware and basic troubleshooting.
Ability to prepare lesson plans, practical exercises, and training materials.
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and effectively to students at different levels.
Strong classroom and laboratory management skills.
Familiarity with current computer technologies and software applications.
Ability to assess students through practical assignments, quizzes, and examinations.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Strong sense of responsibility, professionalism, and commitment.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Willingness to continuously update technical knowledge and teaching skills.
Willingness to work full-time according to the organization’s schedule.
